title: The constant group scheme T_E and the group law on its T-valued points
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $E$ an abelian group. The *constant group scheme* $T_E$ with value $E$ over $T$ is the coproduct $T_E=\coprod_{e\in E}T$ of copies of $T$ indexed by $E$, with coprojections $\iota_e:T\to T_E$ [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family], made a $T$-scheme [def-weil-scheme-over-base] by the structure morphism $\pi:T_E\to T$ with $\pi\circ\iota_e=\mathrm{id}_T$ for all $e$ (the codiagonal). Write $V_e=\iota_e(T)\subseteq T_E$, an open and closed subset, the $V_e$ pairwise disjoint and covering $T_E$. Let $P=T_E\times_TT_E$ be the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] of $\pi$ with itself, with projections $p,q$ and structure morphism $\rho=\pi\circ p=\pi\circ q:P\to T$, and put $W_{e,e'}=p^{-1}(V_e)\cap q^{-1}(V_{e'})$ for $e,e'\in E$; these are open subsets of $P$, pairwise disjoint, and they cover $P$. The *multiplication* $m:P\to T_E$ is the morphism whose restriction to the open subscheme $W_{e,e'}$ is $\iota_{e+e'}\circ\rho|_{W_{e,e'}}$ for all $(e,e')\in E\times E$ (these restrictions glue to a unique morphism by [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-morphism-gluing], the overlaps $W_{e,e'}\cap W_{d,d'}$ being empty for $(e,e')\ne(d,d')$); it is a $T$-morphism, $\pi\circ m=\rho$, and it maps the component $W_{e,e'}$ into the component $V_{e+e'}$. For a $T$-scheme $s:U\to T$ and $T$-morphisms $f,g:U\to T_E$, the *sum* is $f+g:=m\circ(f,g):U\to T_E$, where $(f,g):U\to P$ is the morphism with $p\circ(f,g)=f$ and $q\circ(f,g)=g$; the *constant point* attached to $e\in E$ is $c_e:=\iota_e\circ s:U\to T_E$. The map $E\to\operatorname{Mor}_T(U,T_E)$, $e\mapsto c_e$, is the *canonical map*.

source.place: Groupoids, Example 39.5.6 (Tag 03YW, label example-constant-group): $G_S$ is the base change of $\coprod_{g\in G}\Spec(\mathbf Z)$, with the multiplication mapping the component of $(g,g')$ to the component of $gg'$; Etale Cohomology, Remark 59.23.2 (Tag 03P5, label remark-constant-locally-constant-maps). Here written directly over $T$ (the base change of $\coprod_g\Spec\mathbf Z$ to $T$ is $\coprod_gT$), with the components $W_{e,e'}$ of the fibre product described as open subsets
